author: GrantInPhoenix
body:
IGN: TheScarletAmmo
Reason: "Combat Logging"
Reason why i should be unbanned: I started lagging (connection lag on my screen) when i was heading back to spawn in Dust Devils then when i saw Posighdun who was like 10 blocks away i tried running away but then everyone on my screen froze (meaning i was lagging) so after i ran for 5 seconds to see if i wasn't gonna lag out, i ended up lagging out, so i just disconnected immediately to reset my connection, but apparently, Posighdun said "that wasn't lag" saying i wasn't lagging (maybe on his screen i wasn't but on my screen i was), he even killed me previously on Rendevous II when i was lagging out (but there i didn't disconnect immediately because i wanted to see if the lag would catch up and i can resume playing but i ended dying to him when i was completely lagged out on my screen) so he claimed that i wasn't lagging during the game in Dust Devils when i was, he knew himself that i was lagging since the Rendevous II game but he never admitted it...

I hope i would be unbanned because this was such an uncalled for ban, quite unfair with the fact that my lag ended up getting me banned... also, is this discrimination towards us players who have bad connection to your server? If possible, can you check my connection history to the server's modem or whatever hosting thing cause i really was lagging in that sequence (in addition, this was my ping below when i lagged out and disconnected from the Dust Devils Game)

replies.body:
Hello TheScarletAmmo,

This was what happen in my view, Me and Pvp_Sirs were rushing and we spotted you and you saw us, you came to pvp us and got some hits on us. However we got some hits on you and you decided to turn around and flee. Just when i was about to get the final hit on you, you logged off or "disconnected", the console reported it. However i did check your chat logs and it appears you were having some connection difficulties so i'll give you the benefit of the doubt. Sorry for any inconvenience. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
